fields.System.Title: INT-103 — Receive master data updates
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a system administrator, I want product and customer changes to flow in from the ERP,
so that master data stays current without manual re-keying.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given an update to a non-frozen field, then it is applied and an event published.
  • - Given an update to a frozen field on a product with stock, then it is rejected and
  • reported — see [FDN-607](../FDN/FDN-607-freeze-fields.md).
  • - Given a new product, then it is created in draft status, not active, so a human
  • reviews physical attributes before stock can be received.
  • - Given an update that would create a duplicate barcode, then it is rejected.
  • - Given a weight or dimension outside a plausible range, then it is rejected.
  • - Given any rejection, then it appears on a report a human reviews daily.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | platform, masterdata |
| Tables | product, product_barcode, partner, dead-letter |
| Risks | Frozen field changed while stock exists ([doc 03 §5](../../../docs/03-master-data.md)); bad data accepted at the edge ([doc 03 §7](../../../docs/03-master-data.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration |
